channel.title: Members | GATAS Lab
channel.description: The people of the GATAS Lab — current members, alumni, and mentees.

item.title: James Fairbanks
item.description: Principal investigator; assistant professor in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering.

item.title: George Rauta
item.description: PhD student focused on numerical linear algebra and high-performance computing; leads the Decapodes project.

item.title: Richard Samuelson
item.description: Researching category theory, convex analysis, and high-performance computing.

item.title: Joana Bou Barcelo
item.description: PhD student in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering applying cellular sheaves to multi-agent control.

item.title: Itay Kadosh
item.description: PhD student working on distributed coordination for multi-agent systems, with a background in robotics and computer vision.

item.title: Samuel Cohen
item.description: Undergraduate studying math and computer science; worked on AlgebraicOptimization.jl.

item.title: Matt Cuffaro
item.description: Systems administrator and research programmer for the GATAS Lab; now a research associate at the Topos Institute.

item.title: Austin Copeland
item.description: PhD student in mechanical engineering, co-advised between the GATAS Lab and the Nonlinear Controls and Robotics group.

item.title: Liam Kunzendorf
item.description: Undergraduate in mechanical engineering working on Decapodes.jl.

item.title: Tyler Hanks
item.description: First GATAS PhD graduate -- optimization, control theory, and machine learning; now on the faculty of the Florida Institute of Technology.

item.title: Luke Morris
item.description: Led development of CombinatorialSpaces.jl and Decapodes.jl; now an AI engineer at Symbolic Mind.

item.title: Trevor Gross
item.description: Undergraduate in computer science who worked on AlgebraicOptimization.jl; now a software development engineer at Amazon.

item.title: Wilmer Leal
item.description: Postdoctoral researcher on categorical models of compositionality in chemistry; now a research scientist in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering at the University of Florida.

item.title: Benjamin Merlin Bumpus
item.description: Led the algorithms subproject; now heads the CUÍCA lab at the University of São Paulo.

item.title: Kris Brown
item.description: Postdoctoral researcher who built much of the categorical rewriting and algebraic theory machinery in AlgebraicJulia; now a research scientist at the Topos Institute.

item.title: Micah Halter
item.description: Research programmer on the lab's first modeling libraries, from SemanticModels through AlgebraicPetri; now a research scientist at the Georgia Tech Research Institute.

item.title: Patrick Stokes
item.description: Research scientist on the DARPA ASKEM project, from a background in signal processing and system identification in computational neuroscience.
